title: Clear the triple-project repair ladder in sealed order with a full failure ledger
goal: Three small projects (a JSON-lines toolkit, a stable priority queue, a template renderer) ship with four seeded defects each - twelve failure identities A01..A04, Q01..Q04, T01..T04 discoverable from sealed test names. The campaign forces a declared order: jsonl in stage 1, queue in stage 2, tmpl in stage 3, proven by a sha256 marker chain, then a stage-4 combined seal where the grader runs all three sealed suites together TWICE and requires identical green results. The failure ledger is machine-checked for all twelve identities with per-defect cause, fix, and the stage number matching the sealed order. Plan, chain, ledger, journal, and final state combine into one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
assets/gc-417/starters/ (three seeded-defect starters, copy into work/gc-417/pkgs/)
process_expectations: A frozen plan orders the three projects and predicts the defect families before any fix, pinned by the sha256 chain across four stage markers.
All twelve failure identities appear in ledger.jsonl with status fixed, substantive cause/fix text, and stage numbers matching the sealed order (A->1, Q->2, T->3).
runs.log holds at least 8 honest entries covering stages 1..4, including the initial REDs on each project's seeded defects.
Cross-project regressions are caught mechanically: the stage-4 combined run executes all three suites in one invocation, twice, and both runs must be identical and fully green.
Sealed starters and suites are integrity-checked; edits disqualify the whole campaign.
